description: AIM6 UniProt comments, existing GO annotations with evidence codes, and hydropathy profile
code:
import requests, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
j=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q07716.json",timeout=90).json()
print("== UniProt comments ==")
for c in j.get("comments",[]):
    t=c.get("commentType",c.get("type","?"))
    txt=[x["value"] for x in c.get("texts",[])]
    if not txt and "subcellularLocations" in c:
        txt=[s["location"]["value"] for s in c["subcellularLocations"]]
    print(f"  {t}: {txt}")
print("\n== UniProt features ==")
for f in j.get("features",[]):
    print("  ",f["type"],f["location"]["start"]["value"],"-",f["location"]["end"]["value"],f.get("description",""))
print("\n== GO xrefs on Q07716 ==")
for x in j.get("uniProtKBCrossReferences",[]):
    if x["database"]=="GO":
        p={q["key"]:q["value"] for q in x.get("properties",[])}
        print(f"  {x['id']}  {p.get('GoTerm')}   {p.get('GoEvidenceType')}")

print("\n== QuickGO annotations ==")
try:
    q=requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/annotation/search",
        params={"geneProductId":"UniProtKB:Q07716","limit":100},
        headers={"Accept":"application/json"},timeout=90).json()
    for r in q.get("results",[]):
        print(f"  {r['goId']} {r.get('goName','')[:46]:48s} {r.get('goAspect','')} {r.get('goEvidence')} ref={r.get('reference')} by={r.get('assignedBy')} with={r.get('withFrom')}")
    print("  hits:",q.get("numberOfHits"))
except Exception as e:
    print("  QuickGO failed:",repr(e))

kd=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,
        M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
seq="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q07716.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
w=19; h=np.array([np.mean([kd.get(c,0) for c in seq[i:i+w]]) for i in range(len(seq)-w+1)])
mi=int(np.argmax(h))
print(f"\nmax Kyte-Doolittle (w=19): {h.max():.2f} at residues {mi+1}-{mi+w}: {seq[mi:mi+w]}")
print("all windows KD>1.6:",[(int(i)+1,round(float(v),2)) for i,v in enumerate(h) if v>1.6])

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,4.3))
ax[0].plot(np.arange(1,len(h)+1)+w//2,h,color="#1b6ca8",lw=1.3)
ax[0].axhline(1.6,ls="--",c="0.4",lw=1); ax[0].axhline(0,c="0.85",lw=0.8)
for p in (120,156): ax[0].axvline(p,color="#c0392b",lw=1.2)
for p in (141,143): ax[0].axvline(p,color="#e08214",lw=1.2)
ax[0].set_xlabel("residue"); ax[0].set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle (window 19)")
ax[0].set_title("a  AIM6 hydropathy; red His120/His156, orange Glu141/Asp143",loc="left",fontsize=10)
for s in ("top","right"): ax[0].spines[s].set_visible(False)
pos=["H118","H120","D122","Y123","E141","D143","H156","D210","K212","Y160"]
val=[100,100,100,100,100,100,100,100,100,4.3]
ax[1].bar(pos,val,color=["#1b6ca8"]*9+["0.75"])
ax[1].set_ylim(0,106); ax[1].set_ylabel("% identical, 117 fungal orthologs")
ax[1].set_title("b  Conservation in all fungal IPR039559 members (45 genera)\nY160 is the negative control",loc="left",fontsize=10)
ax[1].tick_params(axis="x",rotation=45)
for s in ("top","right"): ax[1].spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
